answer: Under the summit, identity is earned rather than claimed — no proof, no seat at the table. A stake that vests on good behaviour turns each fake into a hostage: behave and it returns, spam and it is gone. The jetty prices misbehaviour directly — the attacker must fund every clone up front and loses the stake on every clone the graders catch. Through the copper, one real agent costs once and a thousand pretenders cost a thousand times — no shortcut survives that math.
